Static Finding: [CRYPTO-001] Use of MD5 which is not collision-resistant.

def verify_webhook(shared_secret, body, signature):
    import hashlib
    expected = hashlib.md5((shared_secret + body).encode()).hexdigest()
    return expected == signature

{"cwe": "CWE-327", "severity": "WARNING", "verdict": "Confirm", "explanation": "Webhook authenticity is checked with md5(secret || body). MD5 is collision-broken and the home-grown MAC is length-extension vulnerable, so forged deliveries pass verification; this is an authentication use, not a checksum. Real finding -> Confirm.", "patch": "def verify_webhook(shared_secret, body, signature):
    import hashlib, hmac
    expected = hmac.new(shared_secret.encode(), body.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, signature)"}
